newsitem.title: USA: INCSTAR get FDA clearance for tests.
newsitem.headline: INCSTAR get FDA clearance for tests.

text.p: INCSTAR Corp said Wednesday it received clearance from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration to market its second generation tests for the detection of rubella, cytomegalovirus (CMV) and herpes simplex.
These products have been marketed in Europe for several years through the company's affiliate. The estimated U.S. market for these tests is approximately $50 million, INCSTAR said.
INCSTAR said these new products complement its current infectious disease offerings, which include tests for infectious mononeucleosis and hepatitis.

The market release of these new products also reflects the company's global strategy to broaden its product line selection and continue its transition to products that are compatible with automation that is becoming more standardized in the industry, it added.
